_source: behavior_groups/group_comparison.py from frontend/src/data/jellyfish_videos.json; do not edit by hand

dataset.name: Days of our Mice (DooM): a cross-laboratory dataset of mouse social behavior
dataset.citation: Marks, M., Yang, R., Liu, Z., et al. (2026) Days of our Mice (DooM): a cross-laboratory dataset of mouse social behavior (Version 0.261015.2324) [Data set]. DANDI Archive (EMBER). The full author list is at the DOI.

scope: Statistics describe these 50 recordings of one lab only (naive 8, stress 14, social isolation 14, mated 14). They describe observed group differences, not a validated causal effect of any manipulation, and say nothing about the behavior classifier.

design.family: 36 comparisons = 12 metrics x 3 groups vs naive, fixed in group_metrics.PRIMARY and group_comparison.py before any group comparison was looked at
design.test: exact two-sided permutation test on the difference in means (all relabelings enumerated)
design.effect_size: Hedges' g and raw mean difference, percentile bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples; optimistic at these sizes)
design.exploratory: contrasts between the three non-naive groups, and the planned comparisons without time-shifted videos: effect sizes and raw p only

attack_time_pct.label: attack: Time in behavior (% of observation window)

power.assumes: normal data, equal variance, permutation test of means, 8 vs 8 (conservative for 8 vs 14)
